summary: Addressed the round-1 QA blockers by replacing the helper-only UI test with a real `src/main.js` DOM smoke test, and corrected the handoff docs so verification claims now match what was actually exercised.
completed_work: Rewrote `test/appFlow.test.js` to load the actual app entrypoint, simulate textarea input and button clicks, and assert the paste -> validate -> team split -> reset flow through DOM event wiring.

Added `testing/fakeDom.js`, a minimal DOM harness that supports `querySelector`, `innerHTML`, event listeners, form values, and `scrollIntoView` so the app can be exercised without external test dependencies.
Added a second main-entrypoint smoke test for invalid clipboard input to confirm Korean validation errors block result rendering.
Updated `README.md` to describe that `npm test` now covers parser, optimizer, and the `src/main.js` DOM flow.
Updated `FINAL_OUTPUT.md` so its verification section accurately states the new DOM smoke coverage and the remaining live-browser limitation.

verification.result: Passed. `node ./scripts/build.mjs` completed and reported `Built static bundle in dist/.`

verification.command: node --input-type=module -e "import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'; import { buildBalanceFromClipboard } from './src/lib/appFlow.js'; const text = await readFile(new URL('./src/fixtures/samplePlayers.tsv', import.meta.url), 'utf8'); const flow = buildBalanceFromClipboard(text); console.log(JSON.stringify({ errors: flow.errors, scoreDifference: flow.result?.scoreDifference, unrankedDifference: flow.result?.unrankedDifference, totals: flow.result?.teams.map((team) => team.totalScore) }, null, 2));"
verification.result: Returned `errors: []`, `scoreDifference: 0`, `unrankedDifference: 0`, and team totals `[16, 16]` for the bundled sample fixture.
Failed in this sandbox with `PermissionError: [Errno 1] Operation not permitted`, so a socket-based live preview still could not be verified here.

known_gaps: Live browser-engine rendering and manual visual QA against a served `dist/` build are still unverified because this sandbox cannot open a local preview port.
The new UI smoke coverage uses a lightweight fake DOM harness, not a full browser automation stack.
Nice-to-have scope remains unimplemented: role preference ordering, saved player pools, and support for games beyond Overwatch.
handoff_notes: The QA blocker was specifically around `src/main.js`; the new smoke tests now exercise its real event wiring instead of only pure helper/render functions.
Documentation in `FINAL_OUTPUT.md` now matches the actual verification scope from this round.
